# DevTools Box - 開發者工具箱

> 免費線上開發者工具集合，提供 JSON 格式化、Markdown 預覽、文字差異比較等實用工具。

## About

DevTools Box (開發者工具箱) is a free, browser-based collection of developer utilities.
No installation required. All tools run entirely in the browser.

**URL**: https://markdown-json-viewer.pages.dev
**Author**: YC.L
**Language**: Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) with English UI support

## Tools

### JSON 格式化工具 (JSON Formatter)
**URL**: https://markdown-json-viewer.pages.dev/tool/json-tool
Format, validate, and beautify JSON data. Supports JSON with comments (JSONC).
Features: syntax highlighting, error detection, compression, copy output.

### Markdown 即時預覽編輯器 (Markdown Editor)
**URL**: https://markdown-json-viewer.pages.dev/tool/markdown-tool
Real-time Markdown editor with live preview, syntax highlighting, and table of contents navigation.
Features: split-pane view, copy as HTML, scroll sync.

### 文字差異比較工具 (Diff Viewer)
**URL**: https://markdown-json-viewer.pages.dev/tool/diff-viewer
Side-by-side text difference comparator with line-by-line highlighting.
Features: highlight additions, deletions, and modifications for code review.

### 強密碼產生器 (Password Generator)
**URL**: https://markdown-json-viewer.pages.dev/tool/password-generator
Generate strong random passwords with customizable length and character sets.
Features: uppercase/lowercase letters, digits, special characters.

### 文檔檢視器 (Document Viewer)
**URL**: https://markdown-json-viewer.pages.dev/tool/document-viewer
Browser-based viewer for RAG document chunks stored as JSON (pageContent/metadata).
Designed for inspecting and searching these JSON datasets in the browser; not a general Markdown/plain-text renderer.

### TOON 格式轉換器 (TOON Converter)
**URL**: https://markdown-json-viewer.pages.dev/tool/toon-converter
Data format conversion tool for TOON format processing.

## Technical Details

- Built with Nuxt 3 + Vue 3 + TypeScript
- Static site generation (SSG) deployed on Cloudflare Pages
- All processing done client-side — no data sent to servers
- Supports light, dark, and terminal themes
